fields.statement: Reproduction for 'fails before the change': a delay inside the tab Update alone cannot fail the old script, since the tab Update takes the lock before the hook lands. Inject, in internal/api/session.go just before the tab Update, a wait until st.Read(sid) has Status.Hook (poll 5ms, up to 2s), and a 300ms sleep inside the Update closure before r.Tab = tab. Then the old script (HEAD~2's inbox-stalled.txtar) fails 3/3 at the first stalled check (its hook-at edit is dropped; the hook keeps the real time) and the edit-sessions one passes 3/3.
